key_finding: For a symmetric degree-two check with odd syndrome and identical channel priors, one flooding iteration produces exactly zero posterior LLR on both variables. The current hard-decision rule chooses zero at LLR=0 and the current decimation rule breaks equal-reliability ties by lowest variable index. Therefore deterministic tie handling can alter the entire BPGD path even when the update equations are correct.
